title: SpyGlassMeData
description: Datapack that is used by the SpyGlassMe mod.
body:
**SpyGlassMe - Modular Loot Datapack**
*Activate spyglass loot in the chests of your choice!*

This is the official companion datapack for the **SpyGlassMe** mod. It contains a collection of pre-configured loot table files that you can pick and choose from to add the magical spyglasses to specific vanilla structures.

---

### How It Works
The main SpyGlassMe mod automatically generates the entire required datapack folder structure in your world, but the loot folders start empty. This datapack acts as a library of individual loot files.

By copying a file from this pack (e.g., `simple_dungeon.json`) into your world's generated datapack folder, you "activate" spyglass loot for that specific structure. You have full control.

---

### Installation & Usage
1.  **Prerequisite:** Make sure you have the main **[SpyGlassMe Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/spyglassme)** installed and have loaded your world at least once. This creates the necessary empty folders.
2.  **Download & Unzip:** Download and unzip this datapack file on your computer. You will see a collection of `.json` files, each named after a vanilla structure.
3.  **Pick Your Loot:** Choose which structures you want spyglasses to spawn in.
4.  **Copy the Files:** Copy **only the `.json` files** for the structures you have chosen.
5.  **Paste into Your World:** Navigate to your world save folder and paste the copied files into the following directory:
    `...[your_world_save]/datapacks/SpyGlassMe/data/minecraft/loot_tables/chests/`
6.  **Reload:** Load your world and run the command `/spyglassme reload`. The spyglasses will now have a chance to appear in the chests of the structures you selected!

---

### Example Scenario
You only want spyglasses to appear in Desert Pyramids and Shipwrecks.

1.  From the unzipped folder, you would copy `desert_pyramid.json` and `shipwreck_treasure.json`.
2.  You would then paste those two files into the `chests` folder mentioned in the instructions above.
3.  After running `/spyglassme reload`, only those two structures will have a chance to contain spyglasses.

---

### Advanced Customization
* **Removing Loot:** To stop spyglasses from appearing in a certain structure, simply delete its corresponding `.json` file from your world's datapack folder and run `/spyglassme reload`.
* **Changing Chances:** You can open any `.json` file with a text editor to modify the loot chances or conditions.

---

### Requirements
* **This datapack will work without the main mod but will be useless!**
* You must have the **[SpyGlassMe Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/spyglassme)** installed.
